name: smwsprites-trampoline
title: Trampoline
description:
I was thinking about them beanz... so I made this!
A trampoline, a bean bridge, a tightrope... whatever you want to call it!

It's kinda like a wall springboard that's attached on both ends.
Y speeds, the sound it plays, and even if it's bouncy or not can be configured in the .asm file.
